what: Sends the unaudited-send reconciler has already reported, keyed by (inbox, AgentMail message id). A run alerts only on sends absent from this file.
why: ss#2386. Without a memory the reconciler filed a fresh prio:P1 issue every scheduled run re-reporting the same 11 finds (#2344, #2373, #2380, #2381, #2382 are five copies of one finding). A watchdog that cries daily about stale finds trains the reader to skim it, which is how the real alert gets missed.
how_to_update: This repo takes no pushes to main, so the reconciler can never write its own memory. It prints ready-to-paste entries at the foot of every report; add them here in a PR. Silencing a send is therefore a reviewed act, exactly like adding an inbox to KNOWN_NON_SEAT_INBOXES.
not_a_disposition: An entry here means REPORTED AND TRACKED, never RESOLVED. The disposition of the 11 seed entries is tracked on the canonical issue named in reported_in; removing an entry makes the reconciler report that send again on the next run.
provenance: The 11 seed entries were captured, not authored: operator/bin/tests/fixtures/unaudited-sends-2026-08-17.json is the --json output of the reconciler against the live pilot inbox on 2026-08-17, and matches the find list in the body of #2382.
redaction: Recipient addresses on the client's own domain are replaced with client-principal@firm.example, per tests/client-identity-gate.test.ts. Nothing that MATCHES is redacted: message ids and timestamps are verbatim, and to/subject are description only.
